title: Flying saucer observatory detection over Ottawa and the end of Project Magnet

tellings.quote: it happens a week later it happens on the 8th the thing comes flying over and I was talked to one of the guys who was in the building at the time and he said all the bells went off

plain: In 1954, in Ottawa, Canada, a small station built to detect flying saucers is said to have gone off when something flew right over it. It was part of Project Magnet, a Canadian government study of flying saucers linked to the engineer Wilbert B. Smith, and the story also involves a woman named Frances Swan. The researcher Grant Cameron says it happened a week after it was expected, on the 8th. He talked to one of the men who was in the building at the time, who said "all the bells went off". Cameron ties the episode to the end of Project Magnet.
